issues.failure_explanation: An RKBS need not be closed in \ell_\infty under the sup norm; a continuous embedding into L_1 does not make the image closed; (E,\|\cdot\|_F) need not be complete; and \ell_\infty(X) does not embed into L_1 for arbitrary uncountable X, nor does a uniform distribution generally exist.
